criteria.evidence: Chat owns the last turn's outcome and its recovery commands (message/turn-outcome.ts, message/turn-commands.ts). Interborough's turn-states.ts, the rail footnote path (endsTheTurn, endLabel on ToolCalls, runFinishedNoReply copy and their tests), the Discard and Continue toasts, and the composer's second reconnect line are deleted. A turn that ends on its steps (tool calls only, narrated then tools, last call errored or refused) draws stopped, failed, empty or reconnecting through Chat's anchor after the steps, so its stop note and Retry are gone: chat-conversation-states.test.ts and chat-conversation-stopped.test.ts assert no .chat-note, one outcome, no footnote. Kept on purpose: the stop note with Retry for a failed turn that is the person's message alone (no step made, so no row to anchor after; chat-conversation-states 'a discarded turn keeps the plain stopped line' relies on it), and the Why it failed link on earlier failed attempts (row 20b, COR-2533). Interborough has no private CSS for the stop line or retry.

turn-commands.test.ts (57 cells), chat-turn-commands.test.ts, chat-turn-outcome-anchor.test.ts (3 call shapes by stopped/failed/empty, commands once, plus a dropped stream), turn-outcome-anchor.test.ts (3 shapes by 4 outcomes), chat-conversation-states.test.ts (Discard answered after a session switch, refused Discard inline, dropped run said once, Discard on a tool-only stopped turn sends run-states-ended-on-tool), chat-conversation-stopped.test.ts (setting refusal after a switch), chat-session-retry.svelte.test.ts, chat-session-reconnect.svelte.test.ts. Red against main at f429470056, 65e0b1ed23 and e9bdab71f4 (review F1: turn-outcome-turns.test.ts, 149 cells with the probe, and the route rows where Discard and Continue acted on the earlier reply's run; F2: a refused or throwing Retry now of a tool-only turn). Design review (R6 width, escalation design pass at 47bd044cf9): the anchor carries no role, so it missed the transcript rule that lifts the wrapper's max-width caps (base min(80%, 48rem), phone 95%) which only a reply matched; it clamped to 80% of the column (95% on phones). chat-message.svelte now lists the anchor beside the reply in the unlayered transcript rule (inline-size and max-inline-size 100%), and Try again takes margin-inline-start: auto in the empty row. A browser geometry test (components/chat/browser/tests/chat-turn-outcome-anchor.playwright.ts, not run here) measures the anchor against the column, the reply, the steps above it, and a user row as negative control, per kind, plus right to left; captures for the tool-only states added to chat-states.spec.ts. Round 3 (red at f486156d6f): what is said on an outcome anchor ends with it (the anchor releases its ledger entry when it unmounts), a command is drawn only in a state it fits (so a refused Retry now never shows once the same anchor is stopped, failed or empty), and the outcome row stands after the turn's last step and before a trailing follow-up (chat-turn-outcome-anchor.test.ts). The stop, the anchor and the carrier now come from one segmentation of the last turn, and a follow-up after the steps no longer moves the anchor. Final design review (13514c4a5c): a refusal is kept in view by the escalation design: container/command-failure-reveal.ts (observers on the transcript and the line, rather than the one-shot scrollIntoView, which is deleted) fed by TurnCommands.failed() in chat.svelte; tested by container/command-failure-reveal.test.ts (12 cells from the probe's cases) and a failed() cell in turn-commands.test.ts; browser: the 'on a phone' test in chat-states.spec.ts (375x812 touch, Discard, 320x640, toPass) and the fixture twin (34rem then 11rem) in chat-turn-outcome-anchor.playwright.ts, not run here (confirm the tool row is 44 px on the first run). One deviation from the verbatim copy: the module's helpers are not exported (knip flags unused exports), so the cells drive keepCommandFailureInView. Status after Discard: the title takes the latest run's stop fact (chatsWithStoppedRun via SessionTasks, which is now always mounted and hides its strip while the title says Stopped or the page draws a stopped or failed turn); route test 'after Discard the title and the chat list both say Stopped, and no Run canceled strip says it again' (red with the old input). The fact is kept while the runs are read again (stale-while-revalidate): it is cleared only while a run is going, and set again when the read after that run settles; route test 'while the runs are read again after a Discard, the title keeps saying Stopped and no strip appears' holds tasks.list pending and was red (header read Done) before the fix. The list, Home and agent chats derive the fact from the query's data, which stays during a refetch, so they do not reset. Round 13 (the last row dimmed under the end fade at 320x640 when the reconnect notice appears): the mechanism is that nothing re-pins a transcript when its own box shrinks with no message arriving; only a new message ran the pin (use-chat-auto-scroll.svelte.ts), so a notice in the composer, a keyboard or a smaller window leaves scrollTop where it was while the end moves away below the box. container/keep-pinned-through-resize.ts (wired in useChatAutoScroll through its existing guards) puts a transcript that rested at its true end back at its end when its box changes size, and never moves one that was scrolled away. Unit cells: keep-pinned-through-resize.test.ts (6, incl. the scrolled-up negative control) and chat-pin-through-resize.test.ts (Chat level, red with the wiring removed: expected 680, received 600). Browser (not run here): components/chat/browser/tests/chat-pinned-resize.playwright.ts with the fixture block behind ?pinnedResize=1: notice while pinned at 320x640 light, the 375 to 320 window shrink, and the scrolled-up negative control. Round 14: the pin and the refusal placement acted at once in a short transcript at wide widths (the pin took the true end, 124 in the unit model, which put the refusal's controls above the box where the placement, which only moves toward the end, cannot pull back). A refusal being kept in view now rests the transcript itself: command-failure-reveal.ts exports commandFailureHeld (a transcript with an unreleased, unstopped placement) and the pin yields while it is held, so the line (the news) rests at the end of the reading box and the controls stay in it; a pinned transcript with no held refusal still rests at its true end. Tests: chat-pin-through-resize.test.ts 'a refusal held in view is not pushed out of the box by the pin when the box shrinks' (red with the yield removed: expected 16, received 124) and a commandFailureHeld cell in command-failure-reveal.test.ts. The Chat spec chat-pinned-resize.playwright.ts did not reproduce the defect at 77eb510aad (the coordinator's control: 3 of 3 passed) because its transcript overflowed and was scrolled to its end, which the browser's own scroll anchoring holds there; it now draws the route's sequence in a 'fits' mode (a transcript sized to its content, resting at scroll position 0, which is its end and which the browser does not anchor; then the notice, or the window 375 to 320, makes it overflow with no message arriving), with the 'long' cases kept as controls. Round 15 (phones: a chat that fit was opened scrolled to its true end; a rest was read a frame late): the escalation design pin-escalation-design.md, sections 4 and 5, applied as written. keep-pinned-through-resize.ts is now the one record of where the transcript rests (from its start once it fitted, at its true end once something put it there), every programmatic rest goes through applyBottomCorrection and is reported to it, an empty transcript is never moved, and a rest with nothing new repeats the rest in force. Unit cases: keep-pinned-through-resize.test.ts (20 plus 6 for startSideRest), chat-pin-through-resize.test.ts (7 new Chat-level cases), all green; browser cases A to D in chat-pinned-resize.playwright.ts and the 'empty' fixture mode, not run here. Section 9 is not implemented. The refusal placement is a different mechanism (a line above the end), kept as is; comments on the fade and the clear-end padding now state the true-end condition. Bureau remains the source of run status and journal replay; the registry keeps workspace-scoped sessions; neither changed.
